description: This file contains implementation code for cache operations in the context of a Linux-based embedded system, specifically for loading a compressed kernel using LZMA on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It provides a function to flush (write back and invalidate) cache lines over a specified address range.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes (writes back and invalidates) the CPU cache over a specified address range, using inline assembly commands tailored for MIPS architecture.

ctags.name: flush_cache
ctags.pattern: /^void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr, unsigned long size)$/
